S7_tomographic_tilt.claim: Relative to the fading coupling (c<0), CPL predicts a redder shear tomography: xi+ low-z/high-z ratio lower by ~4-5 percent (lowest pair -3.9 to -4.4 percent, highest pair -0.3 to +1.1 percent). Next shear releases will prefer the fading (or LCDM) tilt over CPL's, i.e. a positive Delta chi2(CPL - fading) driven by the low-z bins.
S7_tomographic_tilt.falsified_if: Delta chi2(CPL - fading) <= 0, or a positive Delta chi2 that is driven by the high-z bins rather than the low-z bins
S7_tomographic_tilt.scored_by: DES Y6, HSC Y3/final, KiDS COSEBIs, Euclid DR1 cosmic shear analysed at the frozen backgrounds (class_fit_dovekie.json) with nuisances refitted
